title: Consulting projects
summary: Our flagship. Bring us a real data problem and we build a dedicated student team to solve it — shipping production-quality models, pipelines, and dashboards within a single semester.
bullets: Hand-picked team of 4–6 vetted members plus a faculty or alumni advisor
A scoped, semester-long deliverable with weekly check-ins
You keep the code, models, and findings

title: Recruiting & career fairs
summary: Get in front of Berkeley's most rigorous data science students before graduation. From career-fair booths to targeted info sessions, we connect you with members actively looking for internships and full-time roles.
bullets: Booth presence at our data-focused career fair
Resume book and targeted candidate referrals
Company info sessions and coffee chats

title: Speaker events & tech talks
summary: Put your engineers, researchers, and recruiters in front of an engaged technical audience. Share what your team is building, run a workshop, or host a fireside chat with our members.
bullets: Tech talks, workshops, and fireside chats
Brand exposure across our member channels

title: Hackathon sponsorship
summary: Sponsor a challenge track, judge student projects, and recruit directly from the room. Hackathon sponsorship pairs strong brand visibility with a hands-on look at how students tackle your problems.
bullets: Judging and mentorship slots for your team
Direct recruiting from a room of builders

title: Sponsored research
summary: Interested in a longer-horizon collaboration? Partner with us on research initiatives, share proprietary datasets, and co-publish results with a team that treats the problem with academic rigor.
bullets: Work with proprietary or novel datasets
